game_concept: A action defense set in Coastal Port – Fish Market, a fish market full of crates: the shipwright must handle jellyfish swarms while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Signal Logic: Control light signals with conditions so nothing crashes at crossings.
theme: Coastal Port – Fish Market: a fish market full of crates
core_gameplay_loop: In Fish Market, repeat each round: Control light signals with conditions so nothing crashes at crossings. Each round, jellyfish swarms strike the ferry, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the safety value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the ferry from jellyfish swarms in Fish Market: keep the safety meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 55-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: safety drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 55-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 4 (applied tier): Signal Logic
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Signal Logic' (Week 3 slot 9), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Fish Market'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how safety changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against jellyfish swarms in Fish Market.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 55 seconds while safety > 0.
